name: Anub'Rekhan
notes: Numbers follow docs/research/naxxramas/anubrekhan.md. HP 1,665,500 (wiki; classicdb says 1,500,000) is a clock over 313 s, which is an estimate of a typical kill; Classic has no documented enrage. The room is a 60 yd circle sized so a 104 yd straight kite outruns a slowed boss; the real room has an acid moat and a narrow outer ledge, here the kite is a straight run from the north gate to the south alcove and back, because the engine's phase spots give one destination and the boss chases in a straight line anyway. Every coordinate is an estimate. LOCUST SWARM is its own phase, so the movement is real and scored: 3 s cast (spell data), then the boss walks at 60% speed (`bossSpeedMult` 0.6, boss base speed 5 yd/s estimated, 3 yd/s while slowed; real run speed unknown) for 20 s while ticks land every 2 s on anyone within 30 yd of his edge. The first tick is 2 s after the aura lands, per the 2 s periodic trigger. Cadence is DBM-Vanilla's: first swarm at 90 s in the 77 to 109 s window, then every 90 s cast to cast. The tick is 1,000 (875 to 1,125 real); the per-stack growth (`stacks indefinitely`) and Silence + Pacify are NOT modelled: the engine has no silence, a `stun` would root you inside the swarm, which is the opposite of the real danger. A stack that kept hitting you for the full kite in the real game would kill you outright; here it costs HP and points, and the melee and tank who run still eat 1 or 2 ticks as they leave, which is realistic. Impale, Web and scarabs do not stop during the kite in the real fight; the script stops Impale for the kite (the boss is moving, so a fixed lane would be nonsense). IMPALE (3,938 physical, 1 s cast, spell data) is a telegraphed 5 yd wide lane (`placement: lanes`) from the boss toward the raid, 1.2 s warning, 3,900 damage. Lanes are fixed lines from the boss's two tanking spots through the raid body, the ranged position and through melee behind him, so the lesson is to never stand in a line with him and another player. Lane hazards have no `playerChance`, so the aim list does the job: seven lanes, two of them through the ranged spot, put a given Impale through that spot about 29% of the time. The healer spots are 36 yd out to the west, clear of every lane, as the sources ask (healers stay more than 30 yd from him, behind the tank's line). The cadence (every 18 s) is an estimate: no Classic source gives one. The real random target cannot dodge its own lane; the engine cannot make that distinction, so it is represented only as the Impale tank spike on the ghost (Warcraft Tavern: the tank is often in the line), which a healer must cover. Fall damage is folded into the lane hit. CRYPT GUARDS are `killFirst` adds: two at the pull (wiki, Wowhead; here they appear 5.5 s after the pull rather than already standing there, to give the opening raid hold a target-free window) and one new one on every Swarm at the north gate, pulled west to the raid's swarm side (`holdSpot`), as the wiki says. Lifetimes 45, 70 and 20 s stand in for ~204,000 HP each at realistic raid DPS. Cleave, Web (10 s root, Free Action Potion) and Enrage below 50% are not modelled: the engine has no add melee or add debuffs, so only pickup and kill order are scored; Acid Spit is a stacking undispellable debuff on the off-tank (`maxStacks` 6, 125 per second per stack, real 250 per 2 s). CORPSE SCARABS are not tied to the corpse (the engine has no on-death trigger): scheduled `killFirst` waves of 10 appear at the corpse spots at the time each Guard's lifetime ends, standing in for the real 10-per-corpse summon; a player corpse's 5 scarabs are not modelled. Damage is scaled to a 10,000 HP tank, so a tank survives normal play but dies if the healer ignores a spike. His melee is 1,100 per 2 s (classicdb 5,930 to 6,807 pre-mitigation, estimated swing 2 s); a healer who does nothing loses the tank in about 25 s. The passive ghost healing while nobody plays healer is 650 per second. Impale on the tank (spike 3,900, every 30 s, estimate) is the healer's other reason to stay ahead. Mechanics deliberately simplified: the scarabs' aggro on healers (Wowhead), the real ledge path, Aspect of the Pack (the engine's speeds are fixed), Free Action Potion. Corpse scarab counts 5 per player corpse are out because deaths do not happen in a clean run. The kite direction on each swarm is alternating north/south in the script; the real fight usually returns to the opposite alcove the same way.

labels.text: Raid goes west on the swarm

raidWest.label: Raid: west side on the swarm

healerSpot.label: Healers: spread, out of the line

healerSouth.label: Healers: spread, out of the line

otWest.label: Off-tank: west with the new Guard

tank.label: Main tank
tank.description: You hold Anub'Rekhan against the back gate. When his tail lifts and the Locust Swarm cast bar appears, run him across the room to the far alcove and keep him 30 yards behind you the whole time.

offtank.label: Guard tank
offtank.description: You hold a Crypt Guard at the pull, then pick up the new one that appears on every Locust Swarm. Take them away from the raid, face them away, and stay out of the swarm.

melee.label: Melee DPS
melee.description: Crypt Guards and their scarabs first, then his back. When the tail lifts and the cast bar starts, walk out and west at once. Do not stand in a line with him and a friend.

ranged.label: Ranged DPS
ranged.description: Spread out and kill the Crypt Guards first, then the scarabs, then him. Impale travels in a line from him through his target: never stand in a line with him and another player. Run west the moment the tail lifts.

healer.label: Healer
healer.description: His tank takes heavy swings and Impale. Stay at maximum range, out of his lines, and out of 30 yards when the tail lifts. Silenced healers cannot heal the kite.

taunt.label: Taunt
taunt.tip: Taunt forces the boss onto you for a few seconds and puts you on top of the threat table. Press it the moment the boss turns on the raid, never while it is already on you.

attack.label: Attack
attack.tip: Every attack adds threat. Watch the bar: in the red band one more hit pulls the boss off the tank.

heal.label: Heal the tank
heal.tip: A big heal on the tank. Have it landing as the spike hits, not after.

impaleN.label: Impale
impaleN.tip: Impale runs in a straight line from him through whoever he picked and everyone standing in that line gets thrown in the air. Stay out of line with him and your neighbours.

impaleS.label: Impale
impaleS.tip: Impale runs in a straight line from him through whoever he picked and everyone standing in that line gets thrown in the air. Stay out of line with him and your neighbours.

impaleTank.label: Impale on the tank
impaleTank.tip: Impale often clips the tank too. Heal through it.

locustSwarm.label: Locust Swarm
locustSwarm.tip: Tail up, cast bar running: he locks on for 3 seconds and then Locust Swarm hits everyone within 30 yards every 2 seconds for 20 seconds. Everybody except the tank runs west at once. The tank runs him to the far alcove.

locustTick.label: Locust Swarm
locustTick.tip: Every 2 seconds to anyone within 30 yards of him. Get out.

locustFade.label: Locust Swarm fades
locustFade.tip: The swarm is over. He walks at full speed again.

guardWest.label: Crypt Guard
guardWest.tip: A Crypt Guard. The off-tank takes it and faces it away from the raid; everyone else kills it before going back on him.

guardEast.label: Crypt Guard
guardEast.tip: A Crypt Guard. The off-tank takes it and faces it away from the raid; everyone else kills it before going back on him.

cryptGuardNew.label: Crypt Guard
cryptGuardNew.tip: A Crypt Guard. The off-tank takes it and faces it away from the raid; everyone else kills it before going back on him.

scarabsWest.label: Corpse Scarabs
scarabsWest.tip: Ten scarabs from the corpse. Kill them on the corpse before they reach a healer.

scarabsEast.label: Corpse Scarabs
scarabsEast.tip: Ten scarabs from the corpse. Kill them on the corpse before they reach a healer.

scarabsNew.label: Corpse Scarabs
scarabsNew.tip: Ten scarabs from the corpse. Kill them on the corpse before they reach a healer.

acidSpit.label: Acid Spit
acidSpit.tip: The Guard stacks Acid Spit on you. It cannot be dispelled: kill the Guard.

expectations.label: Stay out of line with him and the raid
expectations.tip: Impale runs in a straight line from him through whoever he picked and everyone standing in that line gets thrown in the air. Stay out of line with him and your neighbours.

expectations.label: Pull him to the back gate
expectations.tip: Take him to the wall and hold him there until the next tail lift.

expectations.label: Pick up the west Guard
expectations.tip: Run to it and stand on it, or Taunt it. It runs for the raid the moment it spawns.

expectations.label: Hold your Guard on the north side, facing away
expectations.tip: Its Cleave hits up to three people. Keep it away from the melee.

expectations.label: Ranged: spread, in range
expectations.tip: Keep to your spot and spread out. Nobody stands in a line between him and someone else.

expectations.label: Kill the Guards and scarabs first
expectations.tip: Never put damage on him while a Crypt Guard or scarab is up: they go down first, every time.

expectations.label: Never pull aggro off the tank
expectations.tip: When the threat bar is in the red band, stop attacking until the tank is clear again.

expectations.label: Stay spread at maximum range
expectations.tip: Far enough back that an Impale line through you is rare, and more than 30 yards from him when the tail goes up.

expectations.label: Keep the tank alive
expectations.tip: He hits hard and Impale spikes land on top. Do not let the tank get low.

expectations.label: Keep the tank above half
expectations.tip: Stay ahead of the next Impale.

expectations.label: Run him to the far side
expectations.tip: The instant the tail lifts, run. He follows at 60% speed and the swarm only reaches 30 yards, so keep him at least that far behind you.

threatLostCount.label: Times the boss turned on the raid

aggroPulls.label: Times you pulled aggro
aggroPulls.tip: Stop attacking when the threat bar turns red.

attacksInRed.label: Attacks in the red band
attacksInRed.tip: In the red band one more hit can pull. Wait for the tank.

earlyAttacks.label: Attacks before the tank had the boss
earlyAttacks.tip: Give the tank a few seconds after the pull.

dpsIdle.label: Seconds not attacking when you could
dpsIdle.tip: Every global you can safely use, use. Stop only when the bar is red or the boss is not on the tank.

playerInHazard.label: Seconds standing in something bad
playerInHazard.tip: Nothing on the ground is worth a global. Step out, then carry on.

tankLowSeconds.label: Seconds with the tank under half
tankLowSeconds.tip: Top the tank up before the spike lands, not after.

overheals.label: Wasted heals
overheals.tip: A heal on a full tank is a heal you did not have for the spike.

attacksOffPriority.label: Attacks on the boss while a priority add lived
attacksOffPriority.tip: Face the add and kill it first. The boss can wait.

whelpsOnRaid.label: Adds loose on the raid
whelpsOnRaid.tip: Grab the adds before they reach a raid member and keep them on you.

locustHits.label: Locust Swarm ticks you stood in
locustHits.tip: Tail up, cast bar running: he locks on for 3 seconds and then Locust Swarm hits everyone within 30 yards every 2 seconds for 20 seconds. Everybody except the tank runs west at once. The tank runs him to the far alcove.

cues.notes: Heal the Impale spike, pick up every Guard, run from the swarm.

list.label: Taunt when Anub'Rekhan turns on the raid
list.tip: The moment the boss turns, Taunt. Every second it is on the raid someone is dying.

list.label: Heal the tank when they drop low
list.tip: Under half with a spike coming is where tanks die. Heal now.

list.label: Pick up the Crypt Guard
list.tip: Run to it, stand on it or Taunt it, then drag it to your spot facing away from the raid.

list.label: Pick up the Crypt Guard
list.tip: Run to it, stand on it or Taunt it, then drag it to your spot facing away from the raid.

list.label: Heal the Impale spike
list.tip: Impale just landed on the tank. Refill them before his next swing.

drills.name: The Locust Swarm kite
drills.description: The tail goes up. Run him to the far alcove and keep him 30 yards behind you.

drills.name: Out before the first tick
drills.description: Walk out and west the moment the cast bar starts. Stay out until it fades.

drills.name: Out of the line
drills.description: Impale lines every 7 seconds. Keep out of line with him and the raid.

drills.name: Pick up the Guard
drills.description: A Crypt Guard appears every 18 seconds. Get to it before it reaches the raid.

drills.name: Heal the spikes
drills.description: Impale lands on the tank every 8 seconds. Refill them between spikes.
